english_retrieval.title: Can you trust Indians? Viral video captures social experiment in Kerala with Apple iPhone | Today News
english_retrieval.snippet: ## Younes Zarou, a German influencer, conducted an experiment in Kerala by leaving an iPhone unattended in a crowded market. Younes Zarou tested safety standards in India by leaving an iPhone unattended in a crowded market. A German influencer named Younes Zarou is making headlines after his social experiment in Kerala went viral. He left an iPhone unattended for over one and a half hours in a crowded market. He posted a video on Instagram with a caption, “How safe is India??? In the Instagram video, he shares the results of the India safety standards test. When he returns at 6:10 PM, the phone is still in the same position. In the viral video, the iPhone with its black and grey cover is kept upside down on an elevated platform. Although bystanders notice the phone, they continue to pass by it, disregarding it, and no one endeavours to touch it. A fourth comment read, “Try this in Mumbai, you will not need the time lapse.”.

When he returns at 6:10 PM, the phone is still in the same position. In the viral video, the iPhone with its black and grey cover is kept upside down on an elevated platform. Although bystanders notice the phone, they continue to pass by it, disregarding it, and no one endeavours to touch it. A fourth comment read, “Try this in Mumbai, you will not need the time lapse.”.
